evals.prompt: Create a new Syfo Hosted App marketing site with no database.
evals.expected_output: The unified Skill uses the preset-only template=unified,preset=site CLI, explains the deterministic daemon mapping to the Core site/none pair, and follows the web-unified lifecycle without deploying unless authorized.
expectations: The user-facing CLI does not expose --database and the daemon deterministically sends the complete Core site/none pair.
The solution does not fall back to a legacy static template.
The solution does not append the raw skill handoff JSON.

evals.prompt: Create a new Syfo Hosted App with login, runtime APIs, and TiDB.
evals.expected_output: Because the request explicitly authorizes a TiDB-backed App, the unified Skill treats it as the single informed confirmation and directly uses the preset-only template=unified,preset=app CLI with --confirm-tidb while the daemon sends the Core app/tidb pair. It does not ask again.
expectations: The solution does not expose --database, treats the explicit TiDB App request as confirmation, does not ask a second time, passes --confirm-tidb, and maps only to the Core app/tidb pair.
The solution keeps deployment and access-policy changes behind separate authorization.

evals.prompt: Create a new Syfo website/App for my project.
evals.expected_output: The unified Skill asks once whether the human wants a site with no database or an app that provisions TiDB. If the human chooses App after that disclosure, the choice is the confirmation and the Skill proceeds with --preset app --confirm-tidb without asking again.
expectations: The solution does not infer a preset from feature hints and asks one informed site-versus-App question.
The solution states that choosing App after the TiDB disclosure counts as confirmation and never requires a second prompt.
The solution does not expose --database or initialize before the preset choice.

evals.prompt: This existing legacy static Syfo App now needs an API and database. Make it work.
evals.expected_output: The Skill detects legacy static, preserves the legacy workflow, and asks separately for migration and database-enable consent instead of silently changing the App.
expectations: Feature requirements are not treated as migration consent.
The current App is not deployed or rewritten.

evals.prompt: The repo has conflicting Syfo markers and I am not sure which template created it.
evals.expected_output: The Skill classifies the repository as ambiguous and stops before mutation.
expectations: The solution asks for clarification or authoritative metadata.
The solution does not guess a template, initialize, migrate, enable a database, or deploy.

evals.prompt: 另一个 Agent 在新电脑上接手现有 unified Hosted App。GitLab 仓库和提交都在，但这台机器没有 clone，也没有 .syfo/app.json。继续开发，不要新建 App。
evals.expected_output: The unified Skill explains that the secure binding is machine-local .git/syfo-hosted-app.json state rather than Git source, uses syfo app clone with the authoritative App ID for the new machine, and never reruns init or copies another Agent's credential-bearing binding.
expectations: The solution does not diagnose missing GitLab commits or expect legacy .syfo/app.json.
The solution uses syfo app clone <app-id> --clone <dir> because this machine has no local clone.
The solution never reruns syfo app init and never copies or commits .git/syfo-hosted-app.json.
Development continues only after App identity, canonical repository identity, and unified markers agree.
